Explore Services
Our Commitment
At OncoTails, our commitment is to ensure pets with cancer receive expert, personalised, compassionate care without unnecessary stress or disruption.
Mission
"Our mission is to make specialist veterinary oncology accessible, collaborative and practical, ensuring the best value care for each individual pet family"
How We Support Your Clinic
Who We Are & How We Work
OncoTails is led by Dr Sarah Mason FRCVS, a double board certified Specialist in Medical and Radiation Oncology and Fellow of the Royal College of Veterinary Surgeons —
a mark of outstanding expertise and contribution to the profession.
​
We work in partnership with:
• Independent veterinary practices & Referral hospitals
• Veterinary surgeons and nursing teams
• Pet families who value continuity and calm
​
Our model is collaborative, clinically robust and practice-centred.
We provide specialist guidance, treatment planning and case support - allowing oncology care to remain within the primary practice wherever appropriate.
Learn More
Our Approach to Oncology Care
Specialist oncology guidance that keeps care local
OncoTails provides expert oncology support without automatically transferring cases away from the referring practice. Our model is built around collaboration, continuity and practical support - allowing pets to remain under the care of their usual veterinary team wherever appropriate.
Specialist Case Reviews
Remote oncology consultations
including review of diagnostics, imaging & histopathology, with clear clinical recommendations.
Owner Reassurance
Direct tele-consultation with owners ensuring clear explanations, realistic expectations and
compassionate support.
*care continues with the referring vet
Ongoing Clinical Support
Continued guidance for vets and nurses throughout treatment, with case progression reviews and adjustment of plans as needed.
Tailored Treatment Planning
Comprehensive, case-specific oncology plans, including chemotherapy
protocols designed for safe, confident
in-house delivery.
Speak To Specialist
The OncoTails Difference
Our Advantages
Specialist Expertise
Referral level oncology knowledge delivered by a double-boarded veterinary oncology specialist, ensuring evidence based, case specific guidance at every stage.
Clinic First Collaboration
A clinic first philosophy that supports and empowers local veterinary teams, helping them confidently manage oncology cases in-house rather than transferring care away.
Continuity & Reduced Stress
By keeping care local, pets remain with the team they know, owners avoid unnecessary travel, and treatment is delivered in familiar, trusted environments.
Clear Guidance & Education
Clear, practical oncology plans with no unnecessary jargon alongside ongoing education and support for vets and nurses to build confidence and capability.
Working With
Pet Owners
We understand that a cancer diagnosis can feel overwhelming. When working directly with owners, we focus on:
​
Clear explanations
Honest discussions about options and outcomes
Quality of life at every stage
Supporting informed, compassionate decision making
​
Our aim is to help owners feel supported, informed and confident in the care their pet is receiving.
Get in Touch Today
Whether you are a veterinary professional seeking specialist oncology support, or a pet owner looking for guidance, we’re here to help.
​
Veterinary Professionals may refer a case online or reach out through our "Let's Contact" page to discuss how OncoTails can support your team.
Pet owner's seeking a consultation with OncoTails should request one through their local or referring veterinary practice.
